heroHeadline: NASA RELEASES 800GB+ OF ARTEMIS II LUNAR SCIENCE DATA TO THE PUBLIC
heroSubtitle: Oct 12: NASA publicly released over 800GB of Artemis II mission science data. Oct 11: Crew observed 5 meteor impact flashes on the lunar surface — first direct human observation of lunar impacts — and described unexpected yellow and green color hues.
footerNote: Data sourced from NASA.gov, OIG Reports, SpaceNews, Ars Technica, Congressional appropriations. Tier 1: NASA/ESA/Official. Tier 2: SpaceNews/Ars Technica/Reuters. Tier 3: Planetary Society/AIAA.
